title: Flashback Recording Indicator
description: Small REC / PAUSED HUD overlay when Flashback is capturing.
body:
# Flashback Recording Indicator

A tiny client-side HUD overlay that tells you whether [Flashback](https://modrinth.com/mod/flashback) is actively recording or paused.

## What it does

When Flashback has a recorder active, a small status badge appears in the top-left corner of your screen:

- 🔴 **Red dot + REC** - Flashback is recording
- 🟡 **Amber dot + PAUSED** - Flashback is paused

If no recorder is active, nothing is shown.

## Why

Flashback doesn't have a built-in recording indicator. If you lose track of whether you've paused or are still capturing, you can end up with missing footage or a recording you forgot to stop. This mod makes the state visible at a glance.

## Details

- Client-side only, does not need to be installed on the server
- HUD element is rendered after the boss bar layer
- Semi-transparent background for readability against any scene
- Zero config, install and forget
